title: BAD SUBWAY
author: inspiringgamer

scanner.why: crawler_round_ending, end_game name an ending and are this map's own; script hardcodes cost 50000

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Description Level 1 of my “map series”, this is like a pilot for TV-series kind of. The map is based of Michael Jackson’s music video “Bad”, you’re playing in the subway where the short film was filmed. Your goal is to get enough points to buy the ending. It’s a one room map (Box Map) since it’s a box map, too make it harder drops have been removed (Nuke, Max Ammo, etc…) screen’s: Main Menu buttons; PaP; Power; Perks; Taken from one of the corners of the map; Features: WaW Perks Power Custom Loading Screen/Video* Buyable Ending Risers *The loading screen is finished, the plan is to shorten it a bit, cause at the moment it’s too long imo, if i ever update the map due to glitches or anything like that, i’ll include the loading screen. for now if you want the loading screen, it’s in the map folder folder, copy “nazi_zombie_subway_load” and place it in “C:Call of Duty – World at Warmainvideo” Removed: Drops (Nuke, Max Ammo, etc…) Enjoy the map!

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
